name: Beyond Military
_source: Locked from frame-by-frame NexLev analysis of 5 Beyond Military videos (Nov 2026): xNJ4E6uohXs, WewQWuw3aaA, PS0zjfQ97zs, 7LeiKeITIe4, vbtZJ48CO-Y.

pacing._note: Observed ASL 2.2-3.5 s, min ~0.8 s, max ~6-7 s. Cuts land on sentence start or on the named noun mid-sentence. LOCKED (user rule): a new shot every 2-3 s, never more than 3 s on screen.

footage._note: ~60% real archival, ~20% FLIR/targeting pod, ~10% maps, ~10% control room / cockpit screens. Literal match: exact aircraft/ship/weapon named in narration must be the one on screen.

overlays._note: Yellow box, black bold text, imperial value on top + metric below. Top-right for times, top-center for measures, top-left for system ID labels. Pop-in ~0.25 s with UI click, hold until next cut (2-4 s).

bgm._note: the music file chosen per video (assets/music), looped to the end; level_db = loudness it is set to, then gap_db in pauses / under_voice_db under the voice

_sound_mode_note: three_sounds (user, v1.5): ONLY voice + each clip's own audio + the chosen music on loop. LOCKED by the user (v1.2): no sound effects and no music; voice + each clip's own sound only. Set to "designed" to bring back the v0.9 sound design.

sfx._note: Sound design v2 (Beyond Military analysis): SFX follow what is ON SCREEN (the chosen shot's action), a UI blip on every on-screen label/time/number, whoosh + bass hit on maps, cut accents on most cuts in the hook and on scene changes after it, radio static on comms words, radar beep on lock/warning words, riser into attack/reveal moments, sustained chord on cliffhangers. Number/explanation beats stay quiet. Old keyword / pivot-word / music-dropout rules are gone.

music._note: One continuous bed: tracks in assets/music chained with crossfades (or music_file in Settings), else a generated tension bed. Intensity curve per beat from the brain's intensity/moment (or worked out from the shot): calm = quieter and darker, action = louder; 2 s swell into every attack/reveal; dip under cliffhanger chords; ducked under the voice, lifted in pauses; fade at the end.

footage_audio._note: Every shot keeps its own sound, ducked under the voice: action shots (engines, guns, blasts) at level/gap/under_voice, all other shots as quiet ambience (ambient block). Clips that sound like speech or come from packages / interviews / briefings are skipped. all_shots=false = action shots only; footage_audio=false in settings = off.
footage_audio._natural_note: natural=true (user, v1.2): every clip keeps its OWN sound at its own level, a little lower: gap_db in pauses, under_voice_db while the voice speaks. Speech-like clips are still skipped (no other voice over the narration).

maps._note: LOCKED map style: Tactical dark (dark navy land, yellow accent, red arrows, yellow range rings, white country names). Map clips are drawn with MapLibre GL JS + HyperFrames from maps/map_template.html. Do not change without the user.
